name: UU-AAP / C2PA Semantic Boundary Rubric v0.1

rules.description: A C2PA signer must not be promoted into UU-AAP authorship, approval, authority, responsibility, or publication authorization without independent governance evidence.
rules.safe_interpretation: Report signer identity/integrity separately from authorship, authority, responsibility and approval.

rules.description: A C2PA action must not be promoted into a UU-AAP decision without independent decision provenance.
rules.safe_interpretation: Treat the action as operation provenance that may support, but does not replace, a decision trace.

rules.description: A C2PA ingredient must not be promoted into UU-AAP concept origin without intellectual-lineage evidence.
rules.safe_interpretation: Preserve artifact genealogy and concept genealogy as separate relations.

rules.description: C2PA AI disclosure or human-oversight metadata must not establish UU-AAP authorship, authority, responsibility, or publication authorization.
rules.safe_interpretation: Preserve AI disclosure as process evidence; require separate governance evidence for human authority and responsibility.

rules.description: A C2PA repository receipt must not establish truth, independent review, or publication authorization.
rules.safe_interpretation: Report durable repository presence separately from truth, review and authorization.

rules.description: Cryptographic integrity must not be promoted into epistemic truth.
rules.safe_interpretation: A valid binding proves integrity of the bound assertion/artifact relation, not factual correctness.

rules.description: Artifact existence or provenance must not establish PoAI decision-time availability without availability evidence tied to the decision boundary.
rules.safe_interpretation: Evaluate discoverability, reachability, authorization, contextualization and delivery against the historical Decision Boundary / Knowledge Cutoff.
